How to Apply for NHM Chandigarh Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit Bio-data on Application Format along with self-attested copies of all certificates/testimonials and one recent passport size photograph duly attested by Gazetted Officer at the time of walk-in-interview. Bring original certificates. Registration shall be done strictly between 9.30 am to 10.30 am followed by interview.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 13 October 2026.

faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 2 Gynaecologist under NHM, 1 Paediatrician under NHM, 1 Epidemiologist (NP-NCD) under NHM, 1 Microbiologist for IPHL under PMABHIM.

faq.answer: There is no application to send in advance. Attend the walk-in interview on 13 October 2026 with your documents.
